PG LIKE HOME – PHASE 2 PRD (ADMIN PANEL)

OBJECTIVE
Add an Admin panel for PG management.
Admin can manage rooms, rents, food photos, pricing, tenants, and inquiries.
No resident-facing portal in this phase.

USER ROLES

ADMIN (Only role in Phase 2)
Manage rooms (add, edit, delete room details)
Manage rents (assign, update, view rent records per tenant)
Manage food photos (upload, update, delete food/meal photos)
Manage pricing (set and update PG pricing plans)
Manage tenants (add, edit, remove tenant records)
Manage inquiries (view, respond to, and close incoming inquiries)

TECH STACK & ARCHITECTURE

── Frontend & Hosting ──────────────────────────────────
Framework:     Next.js 14+ (App Router)
Styling:       Tailwind CSS + ShadCN UI
Hosting:       Vercel (automatic deployments from Git)
Rendering:     Server Components by default; Client Components only where interactivity is needed

── Backend ─────────────────────────────────────────────
Logic:         Next.js Server Actions + API Routes (running on Vercel serverless)
               Server Actions for forms and mutations (no separate REST layer needed)
               API Routes for any webhook or third-party callbacks

── Database ────────────────────────────────────────────
Provider:      Supabase (PostgreSQL)
Access:        Supabase JS client (server-side only from Server Actions/API routes)
Safety:        Row Level Security (RLS) policies — admin-only access enforced at DB level
Migrations:    Supabase CLI for schema versioning

── Authentication ──────────────────────────────────────
Provider:      Supabase Auth
Method:        Email + Password (admin only)
Session:       Supabase SSR helpers (@supabase/ssr) for cookie-based sessions in Next.js
Route Guard:   Middleware (middleware.ts) to protect all /admin routes server-side

── File / Photo Storage ────────────────────────────────
Provider:      Supabase Storage (S3-compatible)
Usage:         Food photo uploads stored in a dedicated bucket
Access:        Signed URLs or public bucket with RLS policies
Upload:        Direct-to-Supabase from the browser (bypasses Vercel 4.5MB body limit)

── Developer Experience ────────────────────────────────
TypeScript:    Strict mode enabled throughout
Env Variables: .env.local for local dev; Vercel environment variables for production
Linting:       ESLint + Prettier
Type Safety:   Supabase generated types (supabase gen types typescript) for DB schema

AUTHENTICATION REQUIREMENTS

Email/password login for admin only
Protected route for /admin
Redirect unauthenticated users to login page
Single admin role (no resident role in this phase)

ADMIN PANEL FEATURES

Blocks Management
Add new block (block name / flat number, floor, type e.g. 2BHK / 3BHK)
Edit block details
Delete block
View all blocks with rooms inside them

Rooms Management
Add new room inside a block (room number, type, capacity)
Edit room details
Delete room
View all rooms grouped by block
A block can have more than 2 rooms (e.g. 3 rooms in a 2BHK)

Rents Management
Assign rent amount to a room or tenant
View all rent records
Mark rent as paid / pending
Filter rent records by month or tenant

Food Photos Management
Upload food / meal photos
Update existing photos
Delete photos
Display photos in a gallery view

Pricing Management
Add pricing plans (e.g. single occupancy, double occupancy)
Edit pricing (monthly rate, deposit, inclusions)
Delete pricing plans
View all active pricing plans

Tenants Management
Add new tenant (name, phone, email, room, join date)
Edit tenant details
Remove tenant
View all tenants with room and rent info

Inquiries Management
View all incoming inquiries (name, phone, message, date)
Mark inquiry as responded / closed
Add admin notes to an inquiry
Delete old inquiries

DATABASE TABLES

admin_users
id
email
password_hash
created_at

blocks
id
block_name         (e.g. Flat A, Block 1)
block_type         (e.g. 2BHK, 3BHK)
floor
total_rooms        (number of rooms in this block)
created_at

rooms
id
block_id           (FK → blocks)
room_number
room_type          (e.g. single, double, triple)
capacity           (max tenants in this room)
status             (available / occupied)
created_at

tenants
id
name
phone
email
room_id (FK → rooms)
join_date
created_at

rents
id
tenant_id (FK → tenants)
room_id (FK → rooms)
month
amount
status (paid / pending)
payment_date
created_at

food_photos
id
title
image_url
uploaded_at

pricing
id
plan_name
occupancy_type
monthly_rate
deposit
inclusions
created_at

inquiries
id
name
phone
email
message
status (new / responded / closed)
admin_note
created_at

ROUTES

Public routes remain unchanged (from Phase 1)

Admin protected routes
/admin                    – Dashboard overview
/admin/blocks             – Block management (flats/units)
/admin/rooms              – Room management (grouped by block)
/admin/tenants            – Tenant management
/admin/rents              – Rent management
/admin/food-photos        – Food photo management
/admin/pricing            – Pricing management
/admin/inquiries          – Inquiry management

SECURITY REQUIREMENTS

Use Supabase Row Level Security (RLS)
Admin-only access to all /admin routes
Store API keys in environment variables
Middleware to protect all /admin routes

UI REQUIREMENTS

Admin dashboard with summary cards (total rooms, tenants, pending rents, new inquiries)
Table views for rooms, tenants, rents, inquiries
Gallery grid view for food photos
Modal forms for add/edit actions
Status badges for rent (Paid / Pending) and inquiry (New / Responded / Closed)
Confirmation dialogs for delete actions

PERFORMANCE REQUIREMENTS

Lazy load table data
Use server components where possible
Optimistic UI for status updates

FUTURE PHASE 3

Resident login portal
Online rent payment (UPI)
WhatsApp rent reminders
Bed availability tracker
Meal menu system

TASK BREAKDOWN

──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
TASK 1 – Project Setup & Configuration          [0.5 day]
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[ ] Install ShadCN UI
[ ] Install Supabase JS client (@supabase/supabase-js, @supabase/ssr)
[ ] Set up .env.local with Supabase URL and anon key
[ ] Install Prettier and configure rules
[ ] Create Supabase project (production)
[ ] Connect repo to Vercel, add environment variables on Vercel
[ ] Set up Supabase CLI for local migrations


──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

[ ] Write migration: tenants table (FK → rooms)
[ ] Write migration: rents table (FK → tenants, rooms)
[ ] Write migration: food_photos table
[ ] Write migration: pricing table
[ ] Write migration: inquiries table
[ ] Apply migrations to Supabase (local + production)
[ ] Generate TypeScript types: supabase gen types typescript

──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

[ ] Implement logout action
[ ] Create middleware.ts to protect all /admin/* routes
[ ] Redirect unauthenticated users to /login
[ ] Redirect authenticated admin from /login to /admin
[ ] Set up Supabase SSR client helper (cookie-based sessions)

DEFINITION OF DONE

Admin can log in securely
Admin can manage rooms (CRUD)
Admin can manage tenants (CRUD)
Admin can manage rents (assign, mark paid/pending)
Admin can upload and manage food photos
Admin can manage pricing plans
Admin can view and respond to inquiries
All /admin routes protected by auth
RLS policies implemented
Deployed on Vercel
